title: Transfer between a member's shares
description: Sign in, open the member record, post a share-to-share transfer through the action panel, and return the confirmation number.
goal: Sign in to the teller console, open member {{input.member_id}}'s record, transfer ${{input.amount}} from share {{input.from_share}} to share {{input.to_share}} using the action panel, confirm the posting, and read back the confirmation number.
